info.name: FitFlex API
info.description:
Every FitFlex REST endpoint with example bodies.

**How to use**
1. Start the backend (`mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2`).
2. Run **Auth → Login user (demo)** and **Auth → Login trainer (demo)**. Their test scripts save the JWTs into the collection variables `{{token}}` (user) and `{{trainerToken}}` (trainer).
3. Every other request already sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (or `{{trainerToken}}` in the Trainer folders).

Running the whole collection in order (Collection Runner / newman) walks through the full flow: book → confirm → Jitsi link, group session → join, workout plan, file upload/download, diet plan, progress.
